Paint
Pick brush or eraser and a color, then tap or swipe holds with one finger. The pipette takes the color of the hold you tap as the brush color. Two fingers zoom and move the board. One stroke is one step for Undo.

On the board
Send shows the picture on the board once. With Live on, the board follows every stroke. Live pauses when the connection drops, when you leave PaintBox and when you change boards. Large bright pictures are shown dimmer, within the board’s power limit.

Pictures
Save keeps the picture on this phone. Pictures are never shared.
Quantum\nFour colors, up to 92 LEDs each. Other layers must be off before you paint. Lighting a climb replaces the picture.

Drag the photo with one finger; zoom and turn it with two. Each hold takes the color that covers most of it, as the nearest board color. With “Keep background dark” the photo’s background lights no LEDs: PaintBox finds it at the edge of the photo, and Background lets you tap another color. A new photo is fitted so that its subject fills the board and sits cleanly on the holds; Snap to holds settles it again after you moved it. Black and transparent parts stay off; a black shape on a background that is left off lights white instead. Only the hold colors are saved.
